items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 36:1
items.html: The filling of HaVaYaH of Alfin is nineteen, namely: three Alephs, two Vavs, and a Dalet, which, together with the twenty-six of HaVaYaH itself, amount to forty-five [MAH] in Gematria. And it is known that the discernment of the filling is the coarseness and the screen upon which the coupling with the upper light is made. Therefore they are the discernment of the 19 sparks from BYA, in the secret of MAN, in the inclusion of AVI, until the forty days of the formation of the fetus. And they are discerned as the vitality of the very essence of ZA, namely the discernment of the Nefesh and Ruach within him. (Item 12).
